name: io.github.andronaft/health-os
title: health-os
description: Local-first personal health record: labs, meds, wearables, food log, deterministic safety checks

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector connection string, e.g. postgresql+psycopg://health:PASSWORD@host.docker.internal:5432/health_os. Run migrations and seed first (see README).

environmentVariables.name: READONLY_DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Recommended: connection as the restricted health_readonly login (scripts/setup_readonly.py). Gives DB-level read isolation; sql_query runs only with it.
